Policy

Editorial Policy

Our aim is to give readers a clear, accurate and fair starting point for learning about developers active in Abu Dhabi.

Selection

Developers are chosen by our editors based on an established, publicly visible track record in Abu Dhabi. Inclusion is not a ranking, endorsement or recommendation, and the order in which companies appear has no significance.

Sources

Profiles are written in our own words using publicly available information — principally each developer's official website, published company materials and reputable press coverage. Sources are listed on each profile.

What we don't publish

We do not publish prices, inventory, payment plans, yields or investment projections, and we do not rate or review individual properties.

Logos and trademarks

Company names and logos belong to their respective owners. They are reproduced unaltered, only to identify each company, and never as part of our own branding. Their use does not imply any partnership, sponsorship or endorsement.

Corrections

We review profiles periodically. If you spot an error — including developers wishing to correct factual information or request removal of their logo — write to editor@abudhabi-properties.com and we will review it promptly.

Sponsored content

The guide may in future offer a limited number of clearly labelled sponsored placements. Sponsored content will always be identified as such and will not affect editorial profiles or their selection.
